[package]
name = "const-field-offset"
version = "0.2.0"
authors = ["Slint Developers <info@slint.dev>"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "Derive macro providing const field offsets using core::mem::offset_of!"
repository = "https://github.com/slint-ui/slint"
homepage = "https://slint.dev"

[dependencies]
field-offset = "0.3.2"

[dependencies.const-field-offset-macro]
version = "=0.2.0"
path = "./macro"

[package]
name = "const-field-offset-macro"
version = "0.2.0"
authors = ["Slint Developers <info@slint.dev>"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "Procedural macro to generate constant field offsets using core::mem::offset_of!"
repository = "https://github.com/slint-ui/slint"
homepage = "https://slint.dev"

[lib]
path = "macro.rs"
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
quote = "1.0"
proc-macro2 = "1.0"

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies]
memoffset = "0.9.0"

[dev-dependencies.const-field-offset]
path = ".."

[package]
name = "gst-plugin-webrtc"
version = "0.15.2"
edition = "2024"
authors = ["Mathieu Duponchelle <mathieu@centricular.com>", "Thibault Saunier <tsaunier@igalia.com>"]
license = "MPL-2.0"
description = "GStreamer plugin for high level WebRTC elements and a simple signaling server"
repository = "https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gst-plugins-rs"
rust-version = "1.92"

[package.metadata.capi]
min_version = "0.9.21"

[package.metadata.capi.header]
enabled = false

[package.metadata.capi.library]
install_subdir = "gstreamer-1.0"
versioning = false
import_library = false

[package.metadata.capi.pkg_config]
requires_private = "gstreamer-rtp-1.0 >= 1.20, gstreamer-webrtc-1.0 >= 1.20, gstreamer-1.0 >= 1.20, gstreamer-app-1.0 >= 1.20, gstreamer-video-1.0 >= 1.20, gstreamer-sdp-1.0 >= 1.20, gobject-2.0, glib-2.0, gmodule-2.0"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
chrono = "0.4"
thiserror = "2"
futures = "0.3"
itertools = "0.14"
tokio-stream = "0.1.11"
serde_json = "1"
fastrand = "2.0"
human_bytes = "0.4"
rand = "0.10"
url = "2"
rustls-pki-types = "1"
tracing-log = "0.2"
bytes = "1"
indexmap = "2.13.0"

[dependencies.gst]
features = ["v1_22", "serde"]
package = "gstreamer"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-app]
features = ["v1_22"]
package = "gstreamer-app"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-audio]
features = ["v1_22", "serde"]
package = "gstreamer-audio"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-pbutils]
features = ["v1_22"]
package = "gstreamer-pbutils"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-video]
features = ["v1_22", "serde"]
package = "gstreamer-video"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-net]
features = ["v1_22"]
package = "gstreamer-net"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-webrtc]
features = ["v1_22"]
package = "gstreamer-webrtc"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-sdp]
features = ["v1_22"]
package = "gstreamer-sdp"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-rtp]
features = ["v1_22"]
package = "gstreamer-rtp"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-utils]
package = "gstreamer-utils"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.gst-base]
package = "gstreamer-base"
version = "0.25"

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["fs", "macros", "rt-multi-thread", "time"]

[dependencies.async-tungstenite]
version = "0.34"
features = ["tokio-runtime", "tokio-rustls-native-certs", "url"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.gst-plugin-webrtc-protocol]
package = "gst-plugin-webrtc-signalling-protocol"
version = "0.15.0"

[dependencies.gst-plugin-webrtc-signalling]
package = "gst-plugin-webrtc-signalling"
version = "0.15.0"

[dependencies.tokio-rustls]
version = "0.26"
default-features = false
features = ["logging", "tls12", "ring"]

[dependencies.aws-config]
version = "1.0"
default-features = false
features = ["credentials-process", "rt-tokio"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-sdk-sso]
version = "1.0"
default-features = false
features = ["rt-tokio", "rustls"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-sdk-sts]
version = "1.0"
default-features = false
features = ["rt-tokio", "rustls"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-types]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-credential-types]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-sigv4]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-smithy-http]
version = "0.63"
features = ["rt-tokio"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-smithy-http-client]
version = "1.1.1"
default-features = false
features = ["hyper-014", "legacy-rustls-ring"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-smithy-types]
version = "1.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-sdk-kinesisvideo]
version = "1.0"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["rt-tokio", "rustls"]

[dependencies.aws-sdk-kinesisvideosignaling]
version = "1.0"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["rt-tokio", "rustls"]

[dependencies.http]
version = "1.0"

[dependencies.data-encoding]
version = "2.3.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.url-escape]
version = "0.1.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["charset", "http2", "system-proxy", "rustls-tls", "rustls-tls-native-roots"]
optional = true

[dependencies.rustls]
version = "0.23"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "ring"]

[dependencies.parse_link_header]
version = "0.4"
features = ["url"]

[dependencies.livekit-protocol]
version = "0.7"
optional = true

[dependencies.livekit-api]
version = "0.4"
default-features = false
features = ["signal-client-tokio", "services-tokio", "access-token", "rustls-tls-native-roots"]
optional = true

[dependencies.warp]
version = "0.4"
optional = true
features = ["server"]

[dependencies.ctrlc]
version = "3.4.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.hyper-util]
version = "0.1"
features = ["server", "http2"]

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"
features = ["log"]

[dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3"
features = ["registry", "env-filter"]

[dev-dependencies]
regex = "1"

[dev-dependencies.gst-plugin-rtp]
path = "net/rtp"
version = "0.15.0"

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["signal"]

[dev-dependencies.clap]
version = "4"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies.serial_test]
version = "3.3.1"
features = ["file_locks"]

[lib]
name = "gstrswebrtc"
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[build-dependencies.gst-plugin-version-helper]
version = "0.8"

[features]
default = ["janus", "whip", "web_server", "whep"]
static = []
capi = []
doc = []
aws = ["dep:aws-config", "dep:aws-types", "dep:aws-credential-types", "dep:aws-sigv4", "dep:aws-smithy-http", "dep:aws-smithy-types", "dep:aws-sdk-kinesisvideo", "dep:aws-sdk-kinesisvideosignaling", "dep:data-encoding", "dep:url-escape", "dep:aws-smithy-http-client", "dep:aws-sdk-sso", "dep:aws-sdk-sts"]
janus = []
livekit = ["dep:livekit-protocol", "dep:livekit-api"]
whip = ["dep:reqwest", "dep:warp", "dep:ctrlc"]
web_server = ["dep:warp"]
whep = ["dep:reqwest", "dep:warp"]
whep-client = ["dep:reqwest"]

[[example]]
name = "webrtcsink-stats-server"

[[example]]
name = "webrtcsink-high-quality-tune"

[[example]]
name = "webrtcsink-custom-signaller"

[[example]]
name = "webrtc-precise-sync-send"

[[example]]
name = "webrtc-precise-sync-recv"

[[example]]
name = "whipserver"
required-features = ["whip"]

[[example]]
name = "webrtcsink-define-encoder-bitrates"

[[example]]
name = "whipclient"
required-features = ["whip"]

[[example]]
name = "stream-selector-server"

[[example]]
name = "stream-selector-client"

[[example]]
name = "renegotiation-server"

[[example]]
name = "renegotiation-client"

[[example]]
name = "whepserver"
required-features = ["whep"]

[package]
name = "i-slint-backend-android-activity"
description = "OpenGL rendering backend for Slint"
authors = ["Slint Developers <info@slint.dev>"]
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://slint.dev"
license = "GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0 OR LicenseRef-Slint-Software-3.0"
repository = "https://github.com/slint-ui/slint"
rust-version = "1.88"
version = "1.16.1"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["aarch64-linux-android", "armv7-linux-androideabi", "i686-linux-android", "x86_64-linux-android"]
features = ["native-activity", "aa-06"]
rustdoc-args = ["--generate-link-to-definition"]

[lib]
path = "lib.rs"

[features]
game-activity = ["android-activity-06?/game-activity", "android-activity-05?/game-activity"]
native-activity = ["android-activity-06?/native-activity", "android-activity-05?/native-activity"]
aa-06 = ["android-activity-06", "ndk-09"]
aa-05 = ["android-activity-05", "ndk-08"]
unstable-wgpu-27 = ["i-slint-renderer-skia/unstable-wgpu-27"]
unstable-wgpu-28 = ["i-slint-renderer-skia/unstable-wgpu-28"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.i-slint-renderer-skia]
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/renderers/skia"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.i-slint-core]
features = ["std"]
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/core"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.raw-window-handle]
version = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.android-activity-05]
package = "android-activity"
version = "0.5"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.android-activity-06]
package = "android-activity"
version = "0.6"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.jni]
version = "0.22"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.ndk-08]
package = "ndk"
version = "0.8.0"
optional = true
features = ["rwh_06"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.ndk-09]
package = "ndk"
version = "0.9.0"
optional = true
features = ["rwh_06"]
default-features = false

[build-dependencies]
android-build = "0.1.2"

[package]
name = "i-slint-backend-linuxkms"
description = "OpenGL rendering backend for Slint"
authors = ["Slint Developers <info@slint.dev>"]
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://slint.dev"
license = "GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0 OR LicenseRef-Slint-Software-3.0"
repository = "https://github.com/slint-ui/slint"
rust-version = "1.88"
version = "1.16.1"
build = "build.rs"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
rustdoc-args = ["--generate-link-to-definition"]

[lib]
path = "lib.rs"

[features]
renderer-skia = ["renderer-skia-opengl"]
renderer-skia-vulkan = ["i-slint-renderer-skia/wgpu-28", "drm", "dep:memmap2"]
unstable-wgpu-27 = ["i-slint-renderer-skia/wgpu-27", "drm", "dep:memmap2"]
unstable-wgpu-28 = ["i-slint-renderer-skia/wgpu-28", "drm", "dep:memmap2"]
renderer-skia-opengl = ["i-slint-renderer-skia/opengl", "drm", "gbm", "glutin", "raw-window-handle", "dep:memmap2"]
renderer-femtovg = ["i-slint-renderer-femtovg/opengl", "drm", "gbm", "glutin", "raw-window-handle"]
renderer-femtovg-wgpu = ["i-slint-renderer-femtovg/wgpu", "drm"]
renderer-software = ["i-slint-renderer-software/std", "drm", "dep:bytemuck", "dep:memmap2"]
libseat = ["dep:libseat"]

[dependencies.i-slint-core]
features = ["default", "image-decoders", "svg"]
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.i-slint-common]
features = ["default"]
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/common"
default-features = false

[dependencies.i-slint-renderer-skia]
features = ["default", "kms"]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/renderers/skia"
default-features = false

[dependencies.i-slint-renderer-femtovg]
features = ["default"]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/renderers/femtovg"
default-features = false

[dependencies.i-slint-renderer-software]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/renderers/software"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.input]
default-features = false
version = "0.9.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.xkbcommon]
version = "0.9.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.calloop]
version = "0.14.1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.libseat]
version = "0.2.1"
optional = true
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.nix]
version = "0.30.1"
features = ["fs", "ioctl"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.drm]
version = "0.14.0"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.gbm]
version = "0.18.0"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["drm-support"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.glutin]
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["libloading", "egl"]
version = "0.32.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.raw-window-handle]
version = "0.6.2"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.bytemuck]
optional = true
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.13.1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.memmap2]
version = "0.9.4"
optional = true

[build-dependencies.cfg_aliases]
version = "0.2.0"

[package]
name = "i-slint-backend-selector"
description = "Helper crate to pick the default rendering backend for Slint"
authors = ["Slint Developers <info@slint.dev>"]
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://slint.dev"
license = "GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0 OR LicenseRef-Slint-Software-3.0"
repository = "https://github.com/slint-ui/slint"
rust-version = "1.88"
version = "1.16.1"
build = "build.rs"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["renderer-software"]
rustdoc-args = ["--generate-link-to-definition"]

[lib]
path = "lib.rs"

[features]
backend-winit = ["backend-winit-x11", "backend-winit-wayland"]
backend-winit-x11 = ["i-slint-backend-winit/x11"]
backend-winit-wayland = ["i-slint-backend-winit/wayland"]
backend-linuxkms = ["i-slint-backend-linuxkms/libseat"]
backend-linuxkms-noseat = ["i-slint-backend-linuxkms"]
backend-qt = ["i-slint-backend-qt/enable"]
backend-testing = ["i-slint-backend-testing/internal"]
renderer-femtovg = ["dep:i-slint-renderer-femtovg", "i-slint-backend-winit?/renderer-femtovg", "i-slint-backend-linuxkms?/renderer-femtovg"]
renderer-femtovg-wgpu = ["i-slint-renderer-femtovg/wgpu", "i-slint-backend-winit?/renderer-femtovg-wgpu", "i-slint-backend-linuxkms?/renderer-femtovg-wgpu"]
renderer-skia = ["i-slint-backend-winit?/renderer-skia", "i-slint-backend-linuxkms?/renderer-skia"]
renderer-skia-opengl = ["i-slint-backend-winit?/renderer-skia-opengl", "i-slint-backend-linuxkms?/renderer-skia-opengl", "i-slint-renderer-skia/opengl"]
renderer-skia-vulkan = ["i-slint-backend-winit?/renderer-skia-vulkan", "i-slint-backend-linuxkms?/renderer-skia-vulkan", "i-slint-renderer-skia/vulkan"]
renderer-software = ["i-slint-backend-winit?/renderer-software", "i-slint-backend-linuxkms?/renderer-software"]
rtti = ["i-slint-core/rtti", "i-slint-backend-qt?/rtti"]
accessibility = ["i-slint-backend-winit?/accessibility"]
raw-window-handle-06 = ["i-slint-core/raw-window-handle-06", "i-slint-backend-winit?/raw-window-handle-06"]
system-testing = ["i-slint-backend-testing/system-testing"]
mcp = ["i-slint-backend-testing/mcp"]
unstable-wgpu-27 = ["i-slint-core/unstable-wgpu-27", "i-slint-renderer-skia?/unstable-wgpu-27", "i-slint-renderer-femtovg?/unstable-wgpu-27", "i-slint-backend-winit?/unstable-wgpu-27", "i-slint-backend-linuxkms?/unstable-wgpu-27"]
unstable-wgpu-28 = ["i-slint-core/unstable-wgpu-28", "i-slint-renderer-skia?/unstable-wgpu-28", "i-slint-renderer-femtovg?/unstable-wgpu-28", "i-slint-backend-winit?/unstable-wgpu-28", "i-slint-backend-linuxkms?/unstable-wgpu-28"]
unstable-winit-030 = ["i-slint-backend-winit"]
unstable-libinput-09 = ["dep:input"]
backend-android-activity = ["dep:i-slint-backend-android-activity"]
default = ["backend-winit"]

[dependencies]
cfg-if = "1"

[dependencies.i-slint-core]
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.i-slint-backend-testing]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/backends/testing"
default-features = false

[dependencies.i-slint-core-macros]
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/core-macros"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))".dependencies.i-slint-backend-winit]
features = ["default", "muda"]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/backends/winit"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))".dependencies.i-slint-renderer-skia]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/renderers/skia"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))".dependencies.i-slint-renderer-femtovg]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/renderers/femtovg"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.i-slint-backend-android-activity]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/backends/android-activity"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_os = \"wasm\"))".dependencies.i-slint-backend-qt]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/backends/qt"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.i-slint-backend-linuxkms]
features = ["default"]
optional = true
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/backends/linuxkms"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.input]
optional = true
version = "0.9.0"
default-features = false

[build-dependencies.i-slint-common]
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/common"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.slint]
path = "../../../api/rs/slint"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "compat-1-2", "backend-winit", "renderer-software", "unstable-winit-030"]

[package]
name = "i-slint-backend-winit"
description = "Winit backend for Slint"
authors = ["Slint Developers <info@slint.dev>"]
edition = "2024"
homepage = "https://slint.dev"
license = "GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0 OR LicenseRef-Slint-Software-3.0"
repository = "https://github.com/slint-ui/slint"
rust-version = "1.88"
version = "1.16.1"
build = "build.rs"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["wayland", "renderer-software", "raw-window-handle-06"]
rustdoc-args = ["--generate-link-to-definition"]

[lib]
path = "lib.rs"

[features]
wayland = ["winit/wayland", "winit/wayland-csd-adwaita", "glutin?/wayland", "glutin-winit?/wayland", "copypasta/wayland", "i-slint-renderer-skia?/wayland", "softbuffer?/wayland", "softbuffer?/wayland-dlopen"]

renderer-femtovg = ["i-slint-renderer-femtovg/opengl", "dep:glutin", "dep:glutin-winit"]
renderer-femtovg-wgpu = ["i-slint-renderer-femtovg/wgpu", "dep:i-slint-renderer-femtovg", "unstable-wgpu-28"]
renderer-skia = ["i-slint-renderer-skia"]
renderer-skia-opengl = ["renderer-skia", "i-slint-renderer-skia/opengl"]
renderer-skia-vulkan = ["renderer-skia", "i-slint-renderer-skia/vulkan"]
renderer-software = ["dep:softbuffer", "dep:imgref", "dep:rgb", "dep:i-slint-renderer-software", "i-slint-renderer-software/std", "dep:bytemuck"]
accessibility = ["dep:accesskit", "dep:accesskit_winit"]
raw-window-handle-06 = ["i-slint-core/raw-window-handle-06"]
unstable-wgpu-27 = ["i-slint-core/unstable-wgpu-27", "i-slint-renderer-skia?/unstable-wgpu-27"]
unstable-wgpu-28 = ["i-slint-core/unstable-wgpu-28", "i-slint-renderer-femtovg?/unstable-wgpu-28", "i-slint-renderer-skia?/unstable-wgpu-28"]
default = []

[dependencies]
cfg-if = "1"
pin-weak = "1"
scoped-tls-hkt = "0.1"
webbrowser = "1.2.0"

[dependencies.i-slint-core]
features = ["default"]
version = "=1.16.1"
path = "internal/core"
default-features = false
